column3: MT 42:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; מַשְׂכִּיל (“a maskil”) is rendered “A Contemplation,” and “channels of water” “the water brooks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a multitude keeping festival” is rendered “a multitude that kept a pilgrim feast.”
Close to the Hebrew; הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים (“wait for”) is rendered “Hope in,” and “the salvations of his face” “the help of His countenance.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְחֶרְמוֹנִים (“the Hermons”) is rendered “the heights of Hermon,” and “Mount Mizar” “the Hill Mizar.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּרֶצַח (“a shattering”) is rendered “As with a breaking.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wait for” is rendered “Hope in,” and “salvations” “help.”
